title: Say whether a test-ref full gate can gate a fast-forward landing of a candidate commit with the same tree
outcome: Say whether a test-ref full gate can gate a fast-forward landing of a candidate commit with the same tree
acceptance: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md state unambiguously whether a full gate run on an exact test ref counts for a landing that fast-forwards master to a candidate commit, and if so under which identity (the same commit, or a commit with the same tree), consistent with the candidate-commits bullet.
The change follows the authority-text process: both coordinators' concurrence, the wording sent to Greg, and the final-diff audit.

completion.summary: Clarified that an exact test-ref full gate gates fast-forward landing to that same candidate commit. Landed and installed the reviewed Markdown change; both existing acceptance criteria passed independent post-landing evaluation, with no criterion change.
